comparison.objective: Commission a damper, versus reshuffle a color-sorted deck and deal it in clockwise order.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision tool torque, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and feedback-based iteration; record requires repeated thin-card separation, restacking, and ordered dealing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two bounded impact cycles and setting retention. Record requires no adjacent same-color cards and an unbroken top-card deal sequence to three seats, with drops or shortcuts scoring zero.
comparison.reason: Sequential card rearrangement and dealing are materially different from physical adjustment and response calibration.
